note: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands have no bank branch of their own: AusPayNet's BSB Directory (the full file, read 2026-10-30) lists no BSB at the islands' postcode, 6799, or under their name. The House of Representatives' committee report on the communications of the Indian Ocean Territories (its chapter 5, on Cocos; the PDF was made on 18 March 1999 and cites the department's 1996-97 annual report) says there is no bank as such on the islands but a Commonwealth Bank agency, from which people draw money from their accounts, and that people bank by phone with banks on the mainland. So an account held there is an Australian bank's, numbered as one in Australia. The report is old: no current statement of the islands' banking was reachable (the Department of Infrastructure's pages for the territory gave no answer and the Shire's site answered 403 on 2026-10-30), so this reading rests on the report and the directory's silence.

sources.title: Parliament of Australia, House of Representatives Standing Committee (National Capital and External Territories), report on communications in the Indian Ocean Territories, chapter five: Cocos (Keeling) Islands (PDF created 18 March 1999)
sources.said: There is no bank as such on Cocos Island; however there is a Commonwealth agent. ... People can cash their cheques or draw money from their accounts from the Commonwealth Bank agency.

sources.title: Australian Payments Network (AusPayNet), Static Download Links for BSB Files
sources.said: AusPayNet administers the Bank-State-Branch (BSB) System for financial institutions in Australia. ... The BSB database is updated on the first (NSW) business day of each month.
